$comment: The Look hotspots by kind (GAME_DESIGN 12.1, 12.2, 11.8; BUILD_PLAN S6, the spec's lead call 5): every kind a drawable place's picture carries (a Z op in a base, a scene or a stamp), each looked or silent. A looked kind's Look is the line look.<kind>, or look.<kind>.<place> where a place has its own, and its button's spoken name is look.name.<kind> (content/text/en/look.json); a silent kind has no button, and a tap there shows the picture's composed alt text as its Look (gfx/alt.js: King's Quest's LOOK at the room), with its reason here. Lint P15 holds every kind of every drawable place to this file and every looked kind to its two lines; schemas/hotspots.schema.json is its J01. Shipped in art/art.json as hotspots ({kind: looked}) on a channel with the trail screen. From S7 the cabin's Look and silent kinds are here too (content/home/cabin.json places: the tub and the register post looked; the peak, the chalkboard and the clam shovel silent); lint P17, P15's cabin twin, holds the cabin's kinds to this file and each looked one to its two lines.

lake.doc: A lake basin's water (base_lake_basin): every lake place shares the line until it has its own

far_shore.why: S6's batch stays small: the far shore's firs are the alt text's ring of firs until a later batch gives them words

shore.why: S6's batch stays small: the near shore is the alt text's meadow until a later batch gives it words

meadow.why: S6's batch stays small: the meadow base's ground is its alt text until a later batch gives it words

heather.why: S6's batch stays small: the heather drifts are the meadow's alt text until a later batch gives them words

sky.why: S6's batch stays small: an open sky says no more than the alt text's hour until S8's weather gives it words

olympus.why: S6's batch stays small: Mount Olympus is the skyline's alt text until S16 draws the crest and gives it a Look

cloud.why: S6's batch stays small: the rim's one cumulus waits for S8's weather to say what a cloud means

privy.doc: Deer Lake's privy roof among the firs (privy_roof)

hiker.doc: The hiker sprite, standing or sitting (hiker_idle, hiker_sit): in every trail picture

basin.doc: The rim scene's view down into the Seven Lakes Basin

lunch_lake.doc: The rim scene's Lunch Lake, the basin's biggest

staircase.doc: The rim scene's stone staircase into the basin

tub.doc: The cabin's hot tub on its little deck, covered (S7): a Look until the soak, S25 (lead call 58)

register_post.doc: The cabin's register post, where an old trail leaves into the maples (S7): a Look until the Trail Register, S24b (lead call 58)

peak.why: S7's batch stays small (lead call 58): the peak over the cabin is the alt text's snowy peak until T1's FKT boards make it a place

chalkboard.why: S7's batch stays small (lead call 58): the porch's chalkboard is silent until T2's Hike of the Day writes on it

clam_shovel.why: S7's batch stays small (lead call 58; decision 61): the clam shovel by the shed is drawn and silent until a Looks batch gives it words
